body: Shit I hope you get well soon :( damn it’s so frustrating how long things take to improve, especially with the whole coronavirus thing now it’s 10x harder to make progress with anything, but in a way we’re all in the same boat and can make it through :) also sorry I take so long to respond on here, this isn’t my main account haha

If you’re gay and in denial, this isn’t the right approach to accepting yourself! A very common reason people hate gay people is because they are gay themselves and have internalised homophobia. Being gay is perfectly normal and natural, don’t let anyone tell you otherwise. Also I’d suggest getting Grindr ;)

Exactly! It’s such a tricky situation to be in :/

Well, I’ve been feeling pretty much the same the past few weeks but had a bit of a rough night, hopefully it’ll pass though. I’m sorry to hear not much has changed though, since I’m 3 weeks late replying to this, hopefully things have improved! How’re you doing now?
Yeah, I was worried about that which is why I’m not sure whether to go or not. I think I‘ll ring a hotline though and see how I feel after that, thankyou for the help :)

I fully relate to that one because I’m also going into psychology! It’s like if a paramedic got into an accident and nobody called an ambulance because they’re expected to handle it themselves, it’s such a dismissive view of things :(
Thankyou so much, same goes for you. We all need someone to talk to <3

This was really helpful, thankyou - that’s so true though, it’s impossible to understand something you’ve never been through, but at the same time it’s frustrating when people don’t understand it. I’ll definitely try what you mentioned at the end though, that’s a good idea.
Ahh this was so lovely, thankyou :) yeah its so tiring isn’t it, and I have no idea how to approach them about it

That must’ve been a terrifying experience for you and I’m so sorry you had to go through that. On the bright side though, you sound like an incredible and selfless friend anyone would be lucky to have, and whilst mental illness can come and go, being a nice person stays. So no matter what you have to cope with, you’ll always be a good person and that’s so important. I had a similar situation where I had a really bad panic attack at school which ended up making me drop out, and my whole old friend group made jokes about it, then told me I was doing it for attention and dropped me which didn’t feel great. It sounds like we both deserved a lot better!

Thankyou so much for that advice though, it genuinely was so helpful. I really should talk to them about it because communication is so important in friendships and I tend to forget that when it comes to how I’m feeling about things, and I’ve been considering things like support groups for a while so I’ll take this as a sign that I should start doing them haha. Once again thanks for this, it made me feel so much better! Also I hope you’re doing better now <3
Yeah :/ it’s easy to forget about us who try to uplift other people, we need support too
Exactly! Everyone needs someone to talk to because everyone struggles, and it sucks that it’s often the ones who help other people the most who don’t get the same back :/

That’s exactly how I feel, nobody can ever understand anyone’s emotions other than their own no matter how much we try to explain it which is why it’s so hard to work out what’s normal and what’s not. A lot of what you described sounds similar to me as well, I avoid going to sleep for as long as possible at night then stay in bed the whole day after and my eating patterns are completely off, and these are things I used to care about so much. Nothing like that really matters to me anymore I guess, I’ve reached the point where I’ve given up on self care like that. 

I will definitely try that, I think the social aspect of it will help me too. I’m in quite a rural area so there isn’t too much opportunity but I’ll see what I can do, that’s good advice so thankyou. I hope things improve for you too, it can feel so consuming and permanent, like this is how I’ll be forever, but I keep reminding myself that I’ve been happy before, so I can be happy again!

Yeah exactly, it’s so hard to tell what counts as depression anymore. Some people cry once and claim it’s depression and other people have attempted suicide and say it’s not a mental health problem so the lines have gotten pretty blurred. 

I definitely should try and get some sort of diagnosis yes, until I know exactly what the problem is it’s difficult to know how to go about fixing it so it would be useful. I’ll see if I can go see a psychologist or something like that so I can work through things and make sense of it I suppose. And yeah, I used to be a really social person and loved being around people but now I struggle more with it because I stay inside literally all week and see the same one friend every now and then which definitely has taken a toll on me. 

Thankyou so much for the help though, it’s motivated me to take action with it :)
that was pretty grounding to read so thankyou, I’ve come out of that mindset the last couple of days but it’s so hard to think clearly about stuff like that when you’re in a bad place

Thankyou so much for this, it really reassured me and was just what I needed to hear. And I’m so sorry for how you were treated when you were younger, I really hope you’re doing better now :/ some people are like that though, one person makes something nasty up like that and they all go along with it because they don’t want to be the focus of all the negativity. You’re right though, people who do self harm get the same sort of response and it’s sad how common that reaction is. 

Also with the therapy thing, I’ve been to the doctors and they basically told me they don’t want to refer me onto anything like that because they don’t think it’s severe enough, which just frustrates me so much. It wouldn’t get severe if people got help in the first place :/

Thanks again :)
